lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੰ ਤ ਮਾਨੰ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੰ ਤ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaja(n) ta maana(n) abhimaana(n) ta heena(n) ||
lines.translation: If there is power, then there is pride. If there is egotistical pride, then there will be a fall.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੰ ਵਰਤੰਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: pravirat maaraga(n) varata(n)t binaasana(n) ||
lines.translation: Engrossed in worldly ways, one is ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੇਣ ਅਸਥਿਰੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਭਜਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d bhajan saadh sa(n)gen asathira(n) naanak bhagava(n)t bhajanaasana(n) ||12||
lines.translation: Meditating and vibrating on the Lord of the Universe in the Company of the Holy, you shall become steady and stable. Nanak vibrates and meditates on the Lord God. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪੰਤ ਹਰੀਅੰ ਮਤਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapa(n)t hareea(n) mat tat giaana(n) ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of God, genuine understanding comes to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਗਸੀਧੵਿ ਬੁਧਾ ਕੁਸਲ ਥਾਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bigaseedhy budhaa kusal thaana(n) ||
lines.translation: The intellect blossoms forth, and one finds a place in the realm of celestial bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੵਿੰਤ ਰਿਖਿਅੰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: basyi(n)t rikhia(n) tiaag maana(n) ||
lines.translation: The senses are brought under control, and pride is abandoned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲੰਤ ਰਿਦਯੰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸੰਤ ਗਿਆਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetala(n)t ridaya(n) driR sa(n)t giaana(n) ||
lines.translation: The heart is cooled and soothed, and the wisdom of the Saints is implanted within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹੰਤ ਜਨਮੰ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਲੀਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raha(n)t janama(n) har daras leenaa ||
lines.translation: Reincarnation is ended, and the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਜੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਣਾਂ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: baaja(n)t naanak sabad beenaa(n) ||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the musical instrument of the Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੰਤ ਬੇਦਾ ਗੁਣੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਆ ਸੁਣੰਤ ਬਾਲਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaha(n)t bedaa guna(n)t guneeaa suna(n)t baalaa bahu bidh prakaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Vedas preach and recount God's Glories; people hear them by various ways and means.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿੜੰਤ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: driRa(n)t subidiaa har har kripaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord, Har, Har, implants spiritual wisdom within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਾਚੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam daan jaacha(n)t naanak dainahaar gur gopaalaa ||14||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The Guru is the Great Giver, the Lord of the World. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਹ ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਛੁ ਲੋਕ ਕਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah chi(n)taa maat pit bhraatah nah chi(n)taa kachh lok kah ||
lines.translation: Do not worry so much about your mother, father and siblings. Do not worry so much about other people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਮੀਤਹ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਨਬੰਧਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: nah chi(n)taa banitaa sut meetah pravirat maaiaa sanaba(n)dhanah ||
lines.translation: Do not worry about your spouse, children and friends. You are obsessed with your involvements in Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਏਕ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਪੁਰਖਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕਹ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal ek bhagavaan purakhah naanak sarab jee pratipaalakah ||15||
lines.translation: The One Lord God is Kind and Compassionate, O Nanak. He is the Cherisher and Nurturer of all living beings. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਵਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਚਿਤੰ ਅਨਿਤੵ ਆਸਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: anity vita(n) anity chita(n) anity aasaa bahu bidh prakaara(n) ||
lines.translation: Wealth is temporary; conscious existence is temporary; hopes of all sorts are temporary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਤੵ ਹੇਤੰ ਅਹੰ ਬੰਧੰ ਭਰਮ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਲਨੰ ਬਿਕਾਰੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: anity heta(n) aha(n) ba(n)dha(n) bharam maaiaa malana(n) bikaara(n) ||
lines.translation: The bonds of love, attachment, egotism, doubt, Maya and the pollution of corruption are temporary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਠਰਾਗਨਿ ਨਹ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਮਲੀਣ ਬੁਧੵੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: phira(n)t jon anek jatharaagan nah simara(n)t maleen budhy(n) ||
lines.translation: The mortal passes through the fire of the womb of reincarnation countless times. He does not remember the Lord in meditation; his understanding is polluted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਰਤ ਮਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮਹ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: he gobi(n)d karat maiaa naanak patit udhaaran saadh sa(n)gamah ||16||
lines.translation: O Lord of the Universe, when You grant Your Grace, even sinners are saved. Nanak dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਤਾਲੰ ਜਲੰਤ ਦੇਦੀਪੵ ਬੈਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: gira(n)t gir patit paataala(n) jala(n)t dedeepy baisvaa(n)tarah ||
lines.translation: You may drop down from the mountains, and fall into the nether regions of the underworld, or be burnt in the blazing fire,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੰਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਤੋਯੰ ਤਰੰਗੰ ਦੁਖੰਤ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਜਨਮੰ ਤ ਮਰਣਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: baha(n)t agaah toya(n) tara(n)ga(n) dukha(n)t grah chi(n)taa janama(n) ta maranah ||
lines.translation: or swept away by the unfathomable waves of water; but the worst pain of all is household anxiety, which is the source of the cycle of death and rebirth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਾਧਨੰ ਨ ਸਿਧੵਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਅਸਥੰਭੰ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਧ ਸ੍ਵਜਨਹ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: anik saadhana(n) na sidhyte naanak asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) asatha(n)bha(n) sabad saadh svajanah ||17||
lines.translation: No matter what you do, you cannot break its bonds, O Nanak. Man's only Support, Anchor and Mainstay is the Word of the Shabad, and the Holy, Friendly Saints. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖੵੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਹਤੵੰ ਜਨਮ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੵਾਦੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghor dukhy(n) anik haty(n) janam daaridra(n) mahaa bikhyaada(n) ||
lines.translation: Excruciating pain, countless killings, reincarnation, poverty and terrible misery

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਮਰੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਭਸਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: mita(n)t sagal simara(n)t har naam naanak jaise paavak kaasat bhasama(n) karot ||18||
lines.translation: are all destroyed by meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, O Nanak, just as fire reduces piles of wood to ashes. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੰ ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhakaar simarat prakaasa(n) gun rama(n)t agh kha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the darkness is illuminated. Dwelling on His Glorious Praises, the ugly sins are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਦ ਬਸੰਤਿ ਭੈ ਭੀਤ ਦੂਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: rid basa(n)t bhai bheet dootah karam karat mahaa niramalah ||
lines.translation: Enshrining the Lord deep within the heart, and with the immaculate karma of doing good deeds, one strikes fear into the demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਰਹੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran raha(n)t srotaa sukh samooh amogh darasanah ||
lines.translation: The cycle of coming and going in reincarnation is ended, absolute peace is obtained, and the Fruitful Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੰ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਖੇਮੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: saran joga(n) sa(n)t pri naanak so bhagavaan khema(n) karot ||19||
lines.translation: He is Potent to give Protection, He is the Lover of His Saints. O Nanak, the Lord God blesses all with bliss. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੰ ਕਰੋਤਿ ਅਗ੍ਰਣੀਵਹ ਨਿਰਾਸੰ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: paachha(n) karot agraneevah niraasa(n) aas pooranah ||
lines.translation: Those who were left behind - the Lord brings them to the front. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਭਯੰ ਧਨਵੰਤਹ ਰੋਗੀਅੰ ਰੋਗ ਖੰਡਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: niradhan bhaya(n) dhanava(n)tah rogeea(n) rog kha(n)danah ||
lines.translation: He makes the poor rich, and cures the illnesses of the ill.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੵੰ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagaty(n) bhagat daana(n) raam naam gun keeratanah ||
lines.translation: He blesses His devotees with devotion. They sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਦਾਤਾਰਹ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਿੰ ਨ ਲਭੵਤੇ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham purakh daataarah naanak gur sevaa ki(n) na labhyte ||20||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who serve the Guru find the Supreme Lord God, the Great Giver||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਧਰੰ ਧਰੰ ਧਾਰਣਹ ਨਿਰਧਨੰ ਧਨ ਨਾਮ ਨਰਹਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: adhara(n) dhara(n) dhaaranah niradhana(n) dhan naam naraharah ||
lines.translation: He gives Support to the unsupported. The Name of the Lord is the Wealth of the poor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹ ਬਲਹੀਣ ਬਲ ਕੇਸਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaath naath gobi(n)dah balaheen bal kesavah ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is the Master of the masterless; the Beautiful-haired Lord is the Power of the weak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਦਯਾਲ ਅਚੁਤ ਦੀਨ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਦਾਮੋਦਰਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab bhoot dayaal achut deen baa(n)dhav daamodarah ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Merciful to all beings, Eternal and Unchanging, the Family of the meek and humble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬਗੵ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਹ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਯਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabagy pooran purakh bhagavaanah bhagat vachhal karunaa mayah ||
lines.translation: The All-knowing, Perfect, Primal Lord God is the Lover of His devotees, the Embodiment of Mercy.
